baseline: controlled no-PGO full distribution on this exact source; not the current shipped x64 PGO release recipe
release_scope: cold complete nightly distribution including full tools, docs, MSI and Arm64EC on Arm64; fresh full opt-dist tool/frontend/backend profiles in each optimized job
release_primary: full distribution production wall seconds from before helper construction through completed dist, including fresh training; excludes initial source/tool setup, post-build verification and uploads
release_secondary: actual completed GitHub job started_at-to-completed_at, including setup, validation and artifact uploads; record queue separately
release_pairing: independent clean build VM per variant and replicate; compare within architecture, report CPU model mix; do not claim same-VM pairing
native_linker: baseline and msvc-pgo keep clang-cl/link.exe/lib.exe; llvm-pgo-thin keeps clang-cl but uses lld-link/llvm-lib and both LLVM and Rust ThinLTO
profiles: fresh within each production job; no borrowed profiles; these contrasts measure complete recipes, not an isolated LTO treatment with identical profiles
ironrdp: evaluate the actual resulting release compilers; paired compiler order on each benchmark VM; baseline Cargo and native std shared to isolate compiler effects; five original native commands offline
correctness: all four original native commands outside timing; serial consistently, no skipped tests or retries; previous parallel failure unresolved
uncertainty: release costs independently resample whole build jobs within variant; IronRDP resamples whole matched replicate/VM clusters; 10000 bootstrap draws; three replicas gives limited precision
timeouts: 350-minute safety stop and 360-minute hosted cap; unfinished jobs are right-censored lower bounds, never completed durations or zero benefit
exclusions: pilot excluded; no successful-cell substitution into failed full matrices; amendments before replacement runs; no mixing historical source or compiler-only results
report: one-page Word comparison with release cost increase percent and IronRDP compile savings percent, denominators and qualification limits; no fitted old-to-new timing projection
